relationships.subject: hemp essential oil
relationships.evidence_quote: HEO reduced the serum level of inflammatory cytokines TNF-α to achieve the analgesic effect

key_findings: Hemp essential oil reduced serum TNF-α and mechanical/thermal hyperalgesia in paclitaxel neuropathy mice; CB2 antagonist AM630 suggests CB2 involvement.
HEO inhibited Lewis lung tumor growth and modified T cell levels.
